_comment: Regions registry — single source of truth for plaz multi-region deployments.
Consumed by:
- .github/workflows/deploy-workload.yml  (matrix discover + inline landing-zone)
- .github/workflows/landing-zone.yml     (matrix discover, standalone use only)
- .github/workflows/comin-status.yml     (matrix discover)
- .github/workflows/gateway-power.yml    (manual status/start/deallocate)
- .github/workflows/image-bake.yml       (gallery replication targets)
Fields:
env         Selects infra/environments/<env>-{landing-zone,workload}.bicepparam.
Also passed to az deployment sub create as the deployment name suffix.
location    Azure region (lowercase, no spaces). Becomes the rg-...-<location> suffix.
gateway     Per-region gateway host name (gw1-scus, gw1-sea, ...). Becomes the NixOS
hostname and VM name suffix. Must also exist as nixos/hosts/<gateway>/.
regionCode  Short code used in resource naming (legacy; exported as env var only).
enabled     true = region remains managed. false = regional infrastructure is
torn down on the next push; this is NOT a gateway power switch.
Manual deploy/power operations also require enabled=true.
primary     Optional marker for the project's primary region (gallery + Key Vault).
To enable a new region end-to-end:
1. Append an entry here with enabled=true
2. Create infra/environments/<env>-landing-zone.bicepparam
3. Create infra/environments/<env>-workload.bicepparam
4. Create nixos/hosts/<gateway>/ and register in nixos/flake.nix
5. Push to main — deploy-workload auto-deploys landing-zone + workload in one run.
To disable a region: flip 'enabled' to false (keep the entry) and push.
deploy-workload then tears down that region's compute/network/monitoring
groups and gallery replicas. Re-enable the entry before redeploying.
To remove a region entirely: delete the entry; the next push tears down
its regional resources, and manual redeploy will no longer be available.
To turn a gateway off without deleting resources: gateway-power, action=deallocate.
To turn it back on: gateway-power, action=start. Use the env field as the target.
Workload deployment preserves stopped/deallocated gateways until explicitly started.
The primary region cannot be disabled/removed while shared services are pinned there.
